games:2026-wk12-kentucky-missouri.blurb: No. 17 Kentucky heads to Columbia as a 5.5-point underdog, with ESPN giving Missouri a 61.5% edge. A total of 48.5 suggests a grind, and the Wildcats can't afford another slip in the ranking.

games:2026-wk12-ohio-state-nebraska.blurb: No. 16 Ohio State is only a field goal better than Nebraska in Lincoln, though ESPN still gives the Buckeyes a 71.3% shot. With the number at 41.5, points may be at a premium in a game Ohio State needs for its climb back up.

games:2026-wk12-byu-kansas.blurb: No. 12 BYU lays 5.5 at Kansas with a 71% win probability on ESPN's model. The Cougars are sitting right on the playoff cut line, so there's no margin for a letdown in Lawrence.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-iowa-illinois.blurb: No. 13 Iowa is an 8.5-point favorite at Illinois with a 65.3% win probability, and a 40.5 total that fits the Hawkeyes' style. Iowa sits two spots outside the playoff field, so style points wouldn't hurt.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-arizona-kansas.blurb: No. 19 Arizona is a seven-point road favorite at Kansas State, with ESPN putting the Wildcats of Tucson at 74.5%. The total sits at 52.5.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-virginia-tech-.blurb: No. 5 Miami is favored by 20.5 over Virginia Tech, with ESPN giving the Hurricanes a 96.4% chance. Miami leads the ACC race and should treat this as a get-right afternoon.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-oregon-michiga.blurb: No. 14 Oregon is a 16.5-point favorite in East Lansing and an 86.4% pick by ESPN's model. The Ducks are three spots outside the playoff field and need the resume work.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-smu-notre-dame.blurb: No. 3 Notre Dame hosts SMU as a 20.5-point favorite with a 93.5% win probability. The total of 56.5 hints the Irish offense is expected to do plenty of the scoring.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-western-kentuc.blurb: No. 22 Liberty lays 17.5 at home against Western Kentucky, with ESPN giving the Flames a 91.9% chance. A 53.5 total means covering requires getting the offense rolling early.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-maryland-usc.blurb: No. 18 USC is a 17.5-point home favorite over Maryland and a 93.1% pick by ESPN. With a 57.5 total, the Trojans should have room to pile up points.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-vanderbilt-flo.blurb: No. 23 Florida is favored by 13.5 over Vanderbilt in the Swamp, with ESPN giving the Gators an 84.7% shot. The total sits at a modest 47.5.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-chattanooga-al.blurb: No. 7 Alabama hosts FCS Chattanooga with no line posted. It's a get-right Saturday for the Tide as they chase Georgia in the SEC race.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-wofford-ole-mi.blurb: No. 25 Ole Miss hosts FCS Wofford in a game ESPN's model pegs at 99.7% for the Rebels. No line posted, and no suspense expected.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-arkansas-texas.blurb: No. 8 Texas is a 20.5-point favorite over Arkansas with a 94.2% win probability. The 47.5 total suggests the Longhorns are expected to win this one on the defensive end as much as anywhere.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky slid from 11 to 17 this week, and the advanced numbers aren't rushing to defend the Wildcats -- 42nd in SP+ and 34th in FPI.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State moved up four spots to 16, and the metrics think that's still too low -- the Buckeyes sit fourth in SP+ and fifth in FPI.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: No. 5 Miami controls the ACC's auto bid with No. 10 Wake Forest five spots back -- a workable cushion, but not one the Hurricanes can sit on.

bubbleNotes:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State jumped four spots to the 16 seed, the last rung on the bubble and four spots from the field. The arrow is pointing up, but there's ground to make up.

bubbleNotes:oregon.blurb: Oregon climbed two to the 15 seed, still three spots shy of the field. The Ducks are trending the right direction with work left.

bubbleNotes:byu.blurb: BYU slipped two spots to the 13 seed and now sits one spot from the field -- closest of any bubble team, but moving backward.

bubbleNotes:iowa.blurb: Iowa moved up two to the 14 seed, two spots outside the field. Keep winning and the Hawkeyes are very much in this.

games:2026-wk12-ucla-michigan.blurb: No. 4 UCLA heads to Ann Arbor as just a 3.5-point favorite with a 37.5 total, and ESPN's model sees it as close to a coin flip at 52.9%. The Bruins are the Big Ten's current leader, so a slip in a low-scoring slugfest would reshuffle the league's automatic bid.

games:2026-wk12-san-diego-state-boise-st.blurb: No. 15 Boise State is a 16.5-point home favorite over San Diego State with a 62.5 total, and ESPN gives the Broncos a 93.8% shot. This is the kind of game a climbing team simply has to handle.

games:2026-wk12-texas-tech-baylor.blurb: No. 11 Texas Tech is a 3.5-point favorite in Waco with the total at 55.5 and ESPN leaning Red Raiders at 61.4%. Texas Tech is chasing in the Big 12 race, so there's no margin for a road stumble against Baylor.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-memphis-navy.blurb: Newly ranked No. 24 Memphis is a 3.5-point favorite at Navy in a game with a 67.5 total, the highest number on the board. ESPN gives the Tigers a 63.3% chance, but points should be plentiful.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-houston-west-v.blurb: No. 20 Houston is an 8.5-point road favorite at West Virginia with the total up at 70.5 and a 72.7% win probability. A tidy win keeps the Cougars' ranking intact heading into the final stretch.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-indiana-washin.blurb: No. 6 Indiana travels to Washington laying 7.5 with a modest 43.5 total and a 78.6% ESPN win probability. The Hoosiers sit two spots behind UCLA in the Big Ten pecking order, so every week they need to keep pace.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-lsu-tennessee.blurb: Unranked LSU is a 1.5-point favorite at No. 9 Tennessee, and ESPN's model splits it almost exactly down the middle at 50.1%. With the total at 45.5, expect a tight, defense-tilted night in Knoxville.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-georgia-south-.blurb: No. 1 Georgia is a 16.5-point favorite at South Carolina with an 87% win probability, the clearest edge of the slate. The Bulldogs' hold on the SEC's top spot makes this a game they're expected to control.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-pittsburgh-lou.blurb: No. 21 Louisville lays 14 at home against Pittsburgh with a 50.5 total and a 77.5% ESPN win probability. The Cardinals need the kind of comfortable win that keeps them in the rankings.

predictions:boise-state.blurb: Boise State surged from No. 24 to No. 15, the week's biggest climb, though the analytics are cooler: 22nd in SP+ and 31st in FPI.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA holds steady at No. 4, but the models aren't fully on board — 12th in SP+ and 25th in FPI suggest the Bruins' ranking is running ahead of their profile.

predictions:memphis.blurb: Memphis cracks the Top 25 at No. 24 after being unranked, and the metrics still have catching up to do at 36th in SP+ and 52nd in FPI.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: No. 1 Georgia has real breathing room in the SEC, with No. 7 Alabama the nearest chaser six spots behind. The Tide need help as much as they need wins.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: No. 2 Utah has the Big 12's auto bid in a commanding position, with No. 11 Texas Tech nine spots adrift as the closest pursuer. That's the widest leader-chaser gap of any league.
